title: What are loss-decomp's final figures?
body:
## What exists today

loss-decomp draws three figures: `loss-decomp-hits.pdf` from `plot.py`, a letter page of eight panels off `stages.tbl` and `cutoff-pairs.tbl`, and `loss-decomp-depth-binned.pdf` and `loss-decomp-depth-cumulative.pdf` from `plot_depth.py`, off `depth.tbl`. The ones in `figures/` were drawn on the 12 October cutoffs. Nothing has been drawn on the 15 October cutoffs that survives.

## Open

Which figures loss-decomp contributes to the paper, and what each one shows.

notes.author: jackroddy/6422e305
notes.text: Jack chose v2, the sankey of the five prototypes in tmp-claude/2026-10-29-ld-figure/, with many changes still to come. The changes wait until pid's hmmer scoring (nail-benchmarks-e36d72) is settled.
